US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Copper(II) sulphate is an inorganic copper salt generally used in its pentahydrate form. That form is supplied as blue crystals, granules or powder. FDA describes manufacture by reacting sulphuric acid with copper oxide or copper metal. Its direct-food functions are copper supplementation and specified processing assistance.
more_info.origin: Manufactured by reacting sulphuric acid with copper oxide or metallic copper. The resulting inorganic copper salt is commonly recovered in its pentahydrate form. The FDA definition identifies a chemical manufacturing route.
